originality.rationale: New scientific part: upper bound and exact first-order translation for all pure-equality unary-open InqBT formulas, and the resulting sharp boundary with the published two-coordinate counterexample. Strong earlier FOT-downarrow completeness covers the converse in greater generality, and ordinary monadic SO game collapse is classical; neither is claimed novel. A published two-variable counterexample does not imply the unary positive theorem. Targeted research-record, primary and owned-claim checks did not find an equivalent unary full-InqBT statement; residual priority risk documented.
residual_risks: Some historical literature on one-coordinate inquisitive/weak intuitionistic dependence logic might independently establish the same MSO-to-FO translation; priority is not certified.
The first-order cardinality normal form is conditional on pure equality; wider signatures or two varying coordinates are not covered.
The MSO rank bound is a non-optimal sufficient cut-off and finite checker experiments cannot certify infinite statements.
The original FOT-downarrow converse is explicitly covered by earlier published work; no novelty attaches to that direction.
